title: Trance-Like Fury
description:
Gain the **Rage!** Barbarian Starting Move.

If you already have **Rage!** then you get the following additional benefits and penalties:

bullets: Add your str to your armor
When you *calm down*, mark an additional **Condition**
When you **Trade Blows**, you and your foe have **adv** to their dmg rolls

title: Red Nails
description:
Once per session, when you **become Bloodied**, clear a Condition.

While Bloodied, increase all dmg you deal by 1.

When you deal dmg to a Bloodied foe, it's **piercing**

title: Spine-Chilling Countenance
description: When you **Pull Strings** **by physically overpowering or manhandling them**, roll+STR (instead of +CHA) and, if they go back on their word later, gain **adv** the next Move you roll against them.

title: The Beast Within
description: When you **unleash the beast inside while Angry**, you shapeshift into a hybrid form between yours and one of following animals:

bullets: Bear. You **Resist** mundane weapons and fire
Boar. You **Resist** fear, terror, and intimidation, even from supernatural sources
Wolf. Increase your **dmg dice size** one step

outcomes.text: To put the beast back under requires a great effort; mark a Condition.

title: When It Earns Me
description: When you **Face Death** while Angry, you may also choose the option below.

bullets: Spit in Death's Face. Recover all HP and you don't become Helpless. Don't lock a Condition either.

outcomes.text: When you do, lose access to this Move until you gain it as an advancement again.
